meta_title: Porter for Claude Desktop: move sessions when you hit the limit
meta_description: Free, open-source Mac menu-bar app. When a Claude account hits its usage limit, Porter moves your Claude Code sessions to another account.
hero_lead: Porter carries your Claude Code sessions from an account at its usage limit to one with room left, so you pick up right where Claude stopped.
hero_meta: macOS 14 or later · free and open source · 10 languages
step_1: Claude stops the session at the limit.
step_2: Porter carries it to an account with room.
how_title: The conversation never belonged to an account.
how_body: Claude Code keeps every conversation in its own folder on your Mac, shared by all accounts. What belongs to an account is only Claude Desktop's short list of sessions. Porter moves the entry in that list, clears the limit error and brings along the git worktrees the session uses.
how_backup: Before every change Porter makes a backup, and anything it deletes goes to the Trash.
how_running: A running Claude Desktop keeps its list in memory, so Porter quits it first and opens it again afterwards.
profiles_title: Several Claude Desktops, side by side.
profiles_body: Claude Desktop normally runs one account at a time. With Porter, each profile is its own Claude Desktop with its own sign-in, settings and sessions, in the Dock and in ⌘-Tab like any app. When one account runs out, keep working in the next window.
profiles_links: Optionally, Claude links from the browser open in the profile you used last.
usage_body: Click the porter in the menu bar: each account shows its 5-hour and 7-day usage, the sessions stopped by a limit, and one button to move them where there is room.
usage_live_title: Live usage, when you want it.
usage_live_body: Turn on Live Usage and Porter asks claude.ai every few minutes, with each profile's own session, as Claude's usage screen does. You also see when each limit resets, and limits that apply to one model only, such as Fable.
window_title: All your sessions, in one window.
window_points: Sessions grouped by project, with search and filters|Move or copy them to another account, or drag them onto it|Archive, restore and delete, with a backup before every change|Move a project folder and every session that uses it follows
window_alt: Porter's main window: accounts in a sidebar, sessions grouped by project, and an action bar with Archive, Delete and Move To
cli_body: The same app moves sessions from your scripts.

install_1_body: Get Porter.dmg, open it and drag Porter to Applications.
install_2_body: Porter is not notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway, or run:
install_3_body: Click the porter in the menu bar, make a profile for each account and sign in. From then on Porter updates itself.
honest_1: Porter is unofficial and not affiliated with Anthropic. It works with Claude Desktop's own files, which are undocumented and may change with any update.
honest_2: It works with what Claude Desktop keeps on your Mac: sessions of the Code tab. Chats stay on Anthropic's servers, with their account.
honest_3: Use only accounts you own, and follow the terms of your Claude plan.
close_meta: Requires macOS 14 or later and Claude Desktop.
footer_trademark: Claude is a trademark of Anthropic. Porter is an independent project.
